_doc: GA-V6-2 batch15 EN authored leaflets (20 groups / 100 masters). Faithful translation of the official MFDS easy_drug source used for the KO canonical — no new medical facts, no weakening of indications/contraindications/warnings, no marketing claims. Merged into otc-oral-combo-leaflet-config-batch15.ga.json under each group's `en` block.

6175c7cfbc6b8b54.title: Beecom C Tablet
6175c7cfbc6b8b54.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced physical strength during and after illness, and in old age; to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, and joint pain (such as lower back pain and shoulder stiffness); to relieve beriberi and eye strain, angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis; to relieve pigmentation (melasma, freckles) caused by sunlight and skin conditions; and to help prevent bleeding gums and nosebleeds.
6175c7cfbc6b8b54.usage:
People aged 12 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, twice daily (morning and evening).
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
6175c7cfbc6b8b54.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hyperoxaluria (excessive excretion of oxalate in the urine); pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional enteritis; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; gout or kidney stones; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

This medicine may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values, and may interfere with the detection of glucose in urine tests.

Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist if you take it together with oestrogen-containing oral contraceptives, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, redness, nausea, vomiting, loose stools, dermatitis, unpleasant odour in sweat or breath, hair loss, or restlessness occurs, or if menstruation comes earlier than expected, the flow gradually increases, or bleeding continues for a long time, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins E, B1, B2, B6 and C and relieves neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, stomatitis, eczema, eye strain and pigmentation
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, reduced strength during and after illness, neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, stomatitis, pigmentation

79456d8c2fff00c9.title: Barocomin Gold Tablet
79456d8c2fff00c9.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced physical strength during and after illness, and in old age; to relieve angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis; and to supply zinc.
79456d8c2fff00c9.usage:
People aged 12 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily, after a meal.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
79456d8c2fff00c9.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; hyperoxaluria (excessive excretion of oxalate in the urine); heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; gout; kidney stones; patients with a predisposition to thrombosis (blocked blood vessels); patients deficient in folic acid.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values.

Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist if you take it together with oestrogen-containing oral contraceptives, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, redness, nausea, vomiting, loose stools, gastrointestinal disorder, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, or pulmonary oedema (swelling) occurs, or if menstruation comes earlier than expected, the flow gradually increases, or bleeding continues for a long time, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, C and zinc, and relieves stomatitis, eczema and dermatitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, reduced strength during and after illness, angular cheilitis, stomatitis, eczema

8ed6f9fb16aa7184.title: Bioramin Gold Tablet
8ed6f9fb16aa7184.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced physical strength during and after illness, and in old age. Through the vitamins and other ingredients it contains, this medicine is used to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain such as lower back pain and shoulder stiffness, beriberi, and eye strain.
8ed6f9fb16aa7184.usage:
Adults: take 2 tablets at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
8ed6f9fb16aa7184.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 3 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; hyperoxaluria; gout or kidney stones; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or Sunset Yellow FCF, or a history of it. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist. Patients with a predisposition to thrombosis and patients deficient in folic acid should consult a pharmacist.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take levodopa while taking this medicine. Women taking oestrogen-containing oral contraceptives should consult a pharmacist.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, nausea, vomiting, loose stools, stomatitis, loss of appetite, or abdominal bloating occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a pharmacist. If menstruation comes earlier than expected, the flow gradually increases, or bleeding continues for a long time, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins E, B1, B2, B6 and C and relieves neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, beriberi and eye strain
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, reduced strength during and after illness, neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, eye strain

9f7f626fecc205eb.title: 2XB DQ Tablet
9f7f626fecc205eb.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins D, E, B1, B2, B6, and C during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced physical strength during and after illness, in the growing years, and in old age. Through the vitamins and other ingredients it contains, this medicine is used to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (such as lower back pain and shoulder stiffness), angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis, and to help prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets. This medicine is also used to supply zinc.
9f7f626fecc205eb.usage:
Children aged 8 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
9f7f626fecc205eb.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; hypercalcaemia (excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause); kidney disease; kidney stones; infants under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hyperoxaluria (excessive excretion of oxalate in the urine); pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; infants under 1 year; children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet; gastrointestinal disease such as peptic ulcer, chronic ulcerative colitis, or regional enteritis; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; gout; kidney stones, current or past. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests, and may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values.

Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, levodopa, or oestrogen-containing oral contraceptives. Consult a pharmacist if you take it together with anti-aldosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If stomach discomfort, diarrhoea, constipation, rash, redness, nausea, vomiting, loose stools, loss of appetite, abdominal bloating, dermatitis, unpleasant odour in sweat or breath, hair loss, restlessness, gastrointestinal disorder, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, low blood pressure, pulmonary oedema (swelling), or menstruation that comes earlier than expected, becomes heavier, or continues for a long time occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins D, E, B1, B2, B6, C and zinc and relieves neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, stomatitis and dermatitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, reduced strength during and after illness, growing years, neuralgia, stomatitis

add2b07bc1583454.title: Viscontin M 800 Tablet
add2b07bc1583454.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins B1, B2, B6, and D during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, during and after illness, in the growing years, and in old age. Through the vitamins and other ingredients it contains, this medicine is used to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain such as lower back pain and shoulder stiffness, angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis, and for beriberi, eye strain, and the prevention of poor development of bones and teeth and of rickets.
add2b07bc1583454.usage:
People aged 19 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
add2b07bc1583454.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; hypercalcaemia; sarcoidosis; kidney stones; kidney disease; severe kidney failure; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption; infants under 12 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; a history of kidney stones. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a pharmacist. Patients deficient in folic acid should stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa while taking this medicine. If you take it together with anti-aldosterone agents or triamterene, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist. Patients being given cardiac glycosides should consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, loose stools, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, skin rash, red spots, incomplete contraction, reduced central nervous system function, dizziness, swelling of the face and legs, loss of appetite, erythema, hives, eczema, rash, maculopapular rash, itching, oedema, or oedema and fluid retention in patients with kidney failure or heart failure occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins B1, B2, B6 and D and relieves neuralgia, muscle and joint pain, stomatitis and dermatitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Physical fatigue, during and after illness, growing years, neuralgia, stomatitis, eye strain

8d6181cd7e484a0c.title: Renalmin Tablet
8d6181cd7e484a0c.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins B and C to dialysis patients and to patients with azotaemia caused by chronic kidney failure.
8d6181cd7e484a0c.usage:
Adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
8d6181cd7e484a0c.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 3 months.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hyperoxaluria (excessive excretion of oxalate in the urine); pregnant and breastfeeding women; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of it.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

This medicine may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test values, and may interfere with the detection of glucose in urine tests.

Do not take this medicine together with levodopa.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, loose stools, loss of appetite, stomach discomfort, stomach bloating, abdominal bloating, or allergic hypersensitivity symptoms occur, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamins B and C to dialysis patients and patients with azotaemia from chronic kidney failure
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Vitamin B and C supply in dialysis and chronic kidney failure

7a3c740ee9e83703.title: Wondercal-D Chewable Tablet
7a3c740ee9e83703.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamin D during pregnancy and breastfeeding, in the growing years, and in old age; to help prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets; and to supply calcium in calcium deficiency and other situations requiring calcium.
7a3c740ee9e83703.usage:
Children aged 8 years and over and adults: take 2 tablets at a time, once daily. Children aged 36 months to under 8 years: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily. Let the tablet dissolve in the mouth or chew it.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
7a3c740ee9e83703.caution:
Warning: this medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolised in the body to phenylalanine. Patients with phenylketonuria, who must restrict their intake of phenylalanine, must not take this medicine.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; hypercalcaemia; sarcoidosis; kidney disease; infants under 12 months; kidney stones; severe kidney failure.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet; pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; a history of kidney stones.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Consult a pharmacist if you use this medicine together with cardiac glycosides, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamin D and calcium and helps prevent poor bone and tooth development and rickets
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Vitamin D and calcium supply, poor bone and tooth development, rickets prevention

86ce27ed6717d145.title: Bicaferol Plus Tablet
86ce27ed6717d145.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamin D during pregnancy and breastfeeding, in the growing years, and in old age; to help prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets; and to supply calcium in calcium deficiency and other situations requiring calcium.
86ce27ed6717d145.usage:
Children aged 8 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, once daily.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
86ce27ed6717d145.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants under 12 months; hypercalcaemia (excess calcium in the blood); sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause); kidney disease; kidney stones; severe kidney failure; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: infants under 1 year; children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet; pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women; premature infants and young children; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia; kidney stones, current or past. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about a month, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist if you take it together with cardiac glycosides, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies vitamin D and calcium and helps prevent poor bone and tooth development and rickets
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Vitamin D and calcium supply, poor bone and tooth development, rickets prevention

8da10ae53a23825a.title: Caldiup Chewable Tablet
8da10ae53a23825a.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for calcium deficiency and other situations requiring a supply of calcium.
8da10ae53a23825a.usage:
People aged 12 years and over and adults: take 1 to 2 tablets at a time, once daily. Children aged 3 to 12 years: take half to 1 tablet at a time, once daily. Let the tablet dissolve in the mouth or chew it.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
8da10ae53a23825a.caution:
Warning: this medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolised in the body to phenylalanine. Patients with phenylketonuria, who must restrict their intake of phenylalanine, must not take this medicine.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; infants and children under 3 years; hypercalcaemia; kidney disease; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: vitamin D is secreted in breast milk and may cause hypercalcaemia in the newborn, so breastfeeding women must consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine; children who get plenty of sunlight and eat a normal diet; pregnant and breastfeeding women; heart and circulatory dysfunction; kidney disorder; hypoproteinaemia.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, or antacids. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea while taking this medicine and just before or after a dose.

If nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supplies calcium
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Calcium deficiency and other situations requiring calcium

67a6c8244150d509.title: Denpasa Capsule
67a6c8244150d509.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and for mild to moderate periodontitis.
67a6c8244150d509.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
67a6c8244150d509.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children under 15 years.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: a history of allergic symptoms to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness, itching); a history of allergic symptoms to eggs (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching); an allergic constitution; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of it.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if you are taking any other medicine.

If rash, redness, diarrhoea, loss of appetite, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, stomatitis, or symptoms of Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome) occur — for example fever, erythema, itching, eye congestion, stomatitis, or severe symptoms such as rash and redness with high fever over the skin of the whole body and the mucous membranes of the mouth and throat, or burn-like blistering — stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and mild to moderate periodontitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Gingivitis after periodontal treatment, mild to moderate periodontitis

a8009ef123db1b0f.title: Dentaforce Capsule
a8009ef123db1b0f.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used as supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and for mild to moderate periodontitis.
a8009ef123db1b0f.usage:
Adults: take 1 capsule at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
a8009ef123db1b0f.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children under 15 years; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; a history of hypersensitivity to cosmetics or eggs (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching); an allergic constitution.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

If rash, redness, diarrhoea, loss of appetite, stomach discomfort, nausea, vomiting, stomatitis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, or toxic epidermal necrolysis occurs — fever, erythema, itching, eye congestion, stomatitis, or severe symptoms such as rash and redness with high fever over the skin of the whole body and the mucous membranes of the mouth and throat, or burn-like blistering — stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Supportive treatment for gingivitis after periodontal treatment and mild to moderate periodontitis
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Gingivitis after periodontal treatment, mild to moderate periodontitis

7ebfea340c93bee7.title: Tresorix Forte Tablet
7ebfea340c93bee7.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for loss of appetite.
7ebfea340c93bee7.usage:
Adults: take 2 tablets at a time, twice daily, before breakfast and before the evening meal, for 8 days; from then on take 4 tablets at a time, twice daily, before breakfast and before the evening meal.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
7ebfea340c93bee7.caution:
Warning: this medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolised in the body to phenylalanine. Patients with phenylketonuria, who must restrict their intake of phenylalanine, must not take this medicine.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; glaucoma; urinary retention; elderly people; frail people; newborns; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hyperchloraemic acidosis; kidney failure; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 or a history of allergic reactions to it.

Do not take this medicine together with MAO inhibitors or alcohol.

If dizziness, nausea, rash, malaise, mental confusion, loss of appetite, drowsiness, or, rarely, headache, thirst, or metabolic acidosis occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

summaryTable.How it works: Used for loss of appetite
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Loss of appetite

81f555b1f8c38c77.title: Bokhap Talcid Chewable Tablet
81f555b1f8c38c77.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for heartburn, stomach discomfort, stomach pain, excess stomach acid, nausea, vomiting, a bloated feeling in the stomach, food stagnation, and acid reflux.
81f555b1f8c38c77.usage:
Children aged 15 years and over and adults: take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times daily, before meals or between meals on an empty stomach, chewing it or letting it dissolve in the mouth.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
81f555b1f8c38c77.caution:
Warning: this medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolised in the body to phenylalanine. Patients with phenylketonuria, who must restrict their intake of phenylalanine, must not take this medicine.

Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients receiving dialysis; children under 15 years.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: kidney disorder. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 2 weeks, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves heartburn, excess stomach acid, stomach discomfort and nausea
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Heartburn, stomach discomfort, stomach pain, excess stomach acid, nausea, vomiting

b176b6aee4c65b4f.title: Anytal Triple Tablet
b176b6aee4c65b4f.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to improve the following symptoms associated with peptic ulcer: excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, a bloated feeling in the stomach, food stagnation, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, acid reflux, and indigestion.
b176b6aee4c65b4f.usage:
Adults: take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily, between meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
b176b6aee4c65b4f.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients receiving dialysis; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption; children under 15 years; pregnant women, women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: hypersensitivity to this medicine; high blood pressure; elderly people; heart or kidney disorder; oedema (swelling); liver disorder; low phosphate levels.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

Do not take this medicine together with gastrointestinal analgesics or antispasmodics. Consult a pharmacist if you take it together with potassium-containing preparations, liquorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, etacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide).

If the amount of urine decreases, the face or limbs swell, the eyelids feel heavy, the hands become stiff, blood pressure rises, or headache, myopathy (weakness, cramping or paralysis of the limbs), allergic symptoms (rash, itching), palpitations, drowsiness, dizziness, malaise, or, rarely, constipation or a dry mouth occurs, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist. Rarely, palpitations and raised GOT and GPT levels may occur.

summaryTable.How it works: Improves excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort and indigestion associated with peptic ulcer
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Excess stomach acid, heartburn, stomach discomfort, bloating, food stagnation, nausea

996ad30df85d3b48.title: Spizyme S Tablet
996ad30df85d3b48.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, food stagnation, aiding digestion, and a bloated feeling in the stomach caused by indigestion.
996ad30df85d3b48.usage:
People aged 15 years and over: take 2 tablets at a time. Children aged 8 years to under 15 years: take 1 tablet at a time. Take 3 times daily after meals.
Leave an interval of at least 4 hours between doses.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
996ad30df85d3b48.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children aged 7 years and under; patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: an allergic constitution. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 2 weeks, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

When giving this medicine to a child, do so under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves indigestion, overeating, food stagnation and stomach bloating, and aids digestion
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, food stagnation, stomach bloating

b69f346969f4961f.title: Pancron Tablet
b69f346969f4961f.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, food stagnation, aiding digestion, and a bloated feeling in the stomach caused by indigestion.
b69f346969f4961f.usage:
People aged 15 years and over and adults: take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
b69f346969f4961f.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption; children aged 7 years and under; hypersensitivity to soybean oil, soy, or peanuts.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: an allergic constitution; patients with disorders of fat metabolism such as hyperlipoproteinaemia, diabetic hyperlipidaemia, or pancreatitis, or patients who require careful administration of lipid emulsions; patients at particular risk from fat overload. If symptoms do not improve after taking this medicine for about 2 weeks, stop taking immediately and consult a pharmacist.

Keep strictly to the stated dose and directions.

summaryTable.How it works: Relieves indigestion, overeating, food stagnation and stomach bloating, and aids digestion
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, food stagnation, stomach bloating

b3c0e43517584a43.title: Zestal Tablet
b3c0e43517584a43.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, food stagnation, aiding digestion, and a bloated feeling in the stomach caused by indigestion.
b3c0e43517584a43.usage:
People aged 15 years and over: take 1 to 2 tablets at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Children aged 8 years to under 15 years: take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times daily, after meals.
Keep to the stated dose and directions.
b3c0e43517584a43.caution:
Do not take this medicine if any of the following applies: children aged 7 years and under.

Consult a pharmacist before taking this medicine if any of the following applies: an allergic constitution; pregnant women and women who may be pregnant; hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 4 or a history of allergic reactions to it.
